status: pre-commit — written after docs/22 signed, before any Adam code or arm
question: On the existing Hamming 2×3, do the cliff, the drift gradation, and the frozen–drift crossover reproduce under Adam at the same MSE pin, and does Adam preserve the γ richness manipulation?
why_now: CE found no shared operating point across losses. Adam holds the objective and the pin and varies the update. That answers the reviewer objection that actually gets raised (plain full-batch GD). I3 is licensed as an off-design exception because Adam's per-parameter normalisation undoes μP LR scaling; the richness gate is the check, not an assumption.

i3_exception.why: Adam's per-parameter normalisation partially undoes μP learning-rate scaling. γ must be shown to still separate, not assumed.

design.manipulation: Same Hamming 2×3 as the GD-MSE slice. Four exact Hamming levels at P=16, crossed with three input levels. Optimizer is Adam; loss, targets, streams, architecture, and target_loss=0.05 are held.

optimizer.name: adam
optimizer.not: a search; library defaults. No momentum SGD. No RMSProp.

design.stopping: matched_loss at target_loss 0.05. Sequential K=1. The registered pin transfers because the objective is unchanged.

frozen.what: rule-only at s_r<1; no-change null at s_r=1

drift.what: slow consecutive centre motion; recovers finding 3 vs jump at s_r=1

design.not: P=32. Another classification loss. Per-γ pins. Reopening CE. EWC/replay. Treating consecutive s_r as lag-12 s_r.

first_slice.gamma_0.03_excluded: Not a control. Composition claims licensed at γ ∈ {1, 10}, and only if the richness gate passes.

held_fixed.lr0_provenance: Re-pinned once, uniformly, by the Phase 0 procedure after inherited lr0=5 exploded on the one-arm cell (γ=10 loss 0.5→3e10 in three steps). Decade ladder on frozen × s_r=0.5 × stream 10000, task 0, both γ: 2e-5 strands γ=1 at loss 0.36 (the too-small analog of GD's 0.2); 0.0002 reaches both γ; 0.002 (decade up) still reaches. Pin is 0.0002. Not informed by Hamming cells, reserved-set geometry, or the richness gate. Recorded before any slice. Details: results/adam_lr0_repin.md.
held_fixed.target_loss_provenance: Registered pin. Transfers because the objective is MSE.

primary_cell.quantity: Δ log α (floors) against Hamming, per input level
primary_cell.reported_not_a_reading: Lag-4 series across task position {0,2,4,6,8,10}. Δρ_c against Hamming, including frozen.

richness_gate.population: unique n=8, frozen × s_r=0.5, after task 0, both γ
richness_gate.phase0_gd_reference: 2.53 decades at matched loss, against this 1-decade bar
richness_gate.if_fails: richness_manipulation_collapses. Arm speaks only to the Hamming axis within each γ. Do not interpret γ-dependent claims. Do not pool γ.
richness_gate.when: before the 192-arm slice. Training-only, task 0, unique n=8 of frozen × s_r=0.5. Geometry is not required.

bands_named_before_16_arm_numbers.partial_manipulation: 3 ≤ ratio < 10: stop for a decision; do not launch 192
bands_named_before_16_arm_numbers.richness_manipulation_collapses: ratio < 3: fail clearly; Hamming-only at one γ is a later decision

recovery.cell: At s_r=1, drift vs jump on reserved stream_ids, γ=10, unique n=8, module A, task 0 lag 12.
recovery.must: Keep the sign of finding 3 (gain under drift, loss under jump) or stop. The new streams are not the same object. Skipped if richness_manipulation_collapses, because that reading is a γ=10 claim.

misses.rule: An arm that misses target_loss on any task is unusable and counted.
misses.if_one_arm_misses: Applied: inherited lr0=5 exploded. Re-pinned once, uniformly, to 0.0002 by the Phase 0 procedure. Recorded in results/adam_lr0_repin.md before any slice.
misses.if_still_misses: lr0_miss. Stop. Do not run the slice. Do not re-pin a second time.

one_arm_first.spec: γ=10, s_r=0.5, frozen, first reserved arrangement, a=0, N=300, quadratic, matched_loss, target_loss=0.05, lr0=0.0002 (re-pinned), tracked_stride=2, Adam, MSE
one_arm_first.why: Same cell as the Hamming one-arm. AGENTS.md §5.

readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.stream_property: At γ=10, unique n=8, cliff (h=0 vs h≥2 under frozen and jump), drift post-cliff gradation (0.75 vs 0.25 CIs non-overlapping), and frozen–drift crossover all reproduce the GD-MSE pattern.
readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.learner_property: At least one of cliff / drift gradation / crossover fails. Report which. Do not salvage a stream claim from the survivors after seeing numbers.
readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.finding3_fails_to_recover: At s_r=1, drift vs jump does not keep gain vs loss on Δ log α. Stop. The Adam streams are not the same object.
readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.mixed: γ=10 and γ=1 disagree on stream_property vs learner_property. Not available if richness_manipulation_collapses.
readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.richness_manipulation_collapses: γ=10 / γ=1 of mean ||ΔW||/||W|| after task 0, frozen × s_r=0.5, unique n=8, does not clear one decade. Arm speaks only to the Hamming axis within each γ. Do not interpret γ-dependent claims. Do not pool γ.

operationalization.primary: Unique n=8, module A, task 0, lag 12, Δ log α vs Hamming, per input level, γ=10. 95% CI = mean ± 1.96 SEM. Interpreted only if the richness gate passes.
operationalization.stream_property: Cliff, drift gradation, and crossover all reproduce (same signs and the same resolved-vs-overlapping-CI pattern as GD-MSE).
operationalization.learner_property: At least one of those three fails.
operationalization.finding3_fails_to_recover: At s_r=1, drift mean Δ log α is not > 0 or jump is not < 0 (γ=10, unique n=8).
operationalization.mixed: γ=10 and γ=1 disagree on stream_property vs learner_property.
operationalization.richness_manipulation_collapses: mean weight_change A at γ=10 divided by mean at γ=1, frozen × s_r=0.5, after task 0, unique n=8, is < 3.
operationalization.partial_manipulation: that ratio is in [3, 10). Stop for a decision. Do not launch 192.
operationalization.gamma_1: Reported. Not the primary. Split → mixed, unless the richness gate has already scoped the arm to within-γ Hamming only.

will_not_do: Inform lr0 or stopping from this axis, except the signed one-time Phase 0 re-pin if the inherited lr0 misses.
Treat consecutive s_r as lag-12 s_r.
Expand before the one-arm is reported.
Launch the 192 before the richness gate.
Launch the 192 unless the gate reading is clears_decade.
Interpret γ-dependent claims if the richness gate fails.
